key_provisions_or_claims: Current EU OHS laws and international standards inadequately address smart cobots' physical and mental HRI risks.
Gaps exist between robotics OHS rules and the draft AI Act and AI Liability Directive.
Proposes encoding OHS enforcement directly into smart cobots, using quantum computing for adaptive norm application.
Raises questions of robot legal personality, liability apportionment and explainability.
Recommends a new binding EU OHS Regulation for the SmaCobs age.
annotation.summary_en: Journal article assessing EU occupational health and safety law and standards for smart collaborative robots, identifying gaps with the AI Act and AI Liability Directive. It proposes encoding OHS enforcement into the robots themselves, using quantum computing, and a new binding EU OHS Regulation, discussing legal personality, liability and explainability.
annotation.title_clean: Encoding the Enforcement of Safety Standards into Smart Robots to Harness Their Computing Sophistication and Collaborative Potential: A Legal Risk Assessment for European Union Policymakers
annotation.title_en: Encoding the Enforcement of Safety Standards into Smart Robots to Harness Their Computing Sophistication and Collaborative Potential: A Legal Risk Assessment for European Union Policymakers
